clips.title: The story
paras: Across Lordaeron, Terenas Menethil II carries the weight of a kingdom through war and its aftermath. For more than five decades, he ruled as a wise and diplomatic king, forged the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War, and gave shelter to the young Prince Varian Wrynn. His murder by his corrupted son, Prince Arthas, began Lordaeron’s collapse to the Scourge.

When refugees from Stormwind reached the north with Sir Anduin Lothar, King Terenas Menethil II answered their call. He gathered the monarchs of the divided human kingdoms, along with envoys from Ironforge and Quel'Thalas, and brought them together in the Alliance of Lordaeron. Terenas did not claim command of its armies. He chose Lothar as supreme commander, uniting humanity’s kingdoms for the first time in millennia. Together, they defeated the Old Horde.

After the Second War, Terenas insisted that surviving orcs be held in internment camps rather than executed. He believed peace might hold once their demonic fury faded. The camps placed a heavy tax burden on Lordaeron’s allies. Gilneas shut itself behind the Greymane Wall, Stromgarde left the Alliance over political disputes, and the high elves withdrew entirely. Terenas was left to bear the cost as the coalition fractured.
